requirements.actualResult: Five XCTest cases added, not executed. Closures and view models reject mismatched content, blank titles/bodies/source identifiers, duplicate source identifiers and invalid section associations. Structural preflight does not verify source approval or scientific accuracy. Default unavailable providers and unconnected action callbacks remain a separate PARTIAL production-integration gap; no clinical content was invented.

requirements.requirement: Cycle setup answers must not report failed writes as saved, expose uncommitted snapshots, or lose later edits through actor reentrancy.
requirements.actualResult: Added serialized, cancellation-aware access and rollback of the in-memory draft on failed writes. Six tests exercise write failure, blocked persistence/concurrent edits/snapshots, cancellation, reload/save-queue ordering, and actual shared-context synchronization only after a successful save. Failed optimistic answers cannot alter shared health context; dismissing an error cannot allow completion of an older draft. Not executed in Xcode. Cross-file reconciliation with Prompt13 remains non-atomic if one persistence layer fails after the other has saved; this change does not claim a two-file transaction.

requirements.requirement: Export preparation must not open a destination after navigation away, publish a cancelled/stale document, or mix later MainActor health/game edits into an already captured snapshot.
requirements.actualResult: Added cancellable request-owned preparation; Back/real disappearance cancels preparation, while native Files presentation remains intact. Late cancelled results cannot replace the active document. MainActor domain values are copied before awaiting cycle/setup snapshots. Four new tests cover cancellation, replacement, error and a deliberately blocked cycle-file read with later health/game edits. Not executed on Mac. Existing saved-file byte verification and Cancel/no-success behavior are unchanged.
requirements.limitations: This freezes MainActor data at request time; separately actor-owned cycle/setup snapshots are still individually read and are not a cross-file database transaction.
